objective: Determine whether a quality-qualified Qwen3.8-27B Q3_K_M target plus the official MTP sidecar has enough exact-parity target-call amortization and low enough streamed-weight traffic to justify a high-bandwidth AMD scale test.

experiment.purpose: fixed-width admission and calibration data collection before the separately frozen cost-aware stopping rule

next_action.pass: run the 32-prompt heldout cost-aware stopping validation, then measure STREAM and target kernels on the final AMD candidate
next_action.fail: do not rent the final node; use the trace to choose between a cheaper trained MTP proposer and a lower-byte post-trained target

claim_boundary: Four-prompt Q3 plus MTP development admission only; not a heldout semantic, final-node, 100 tok/s, capability, or novelty result.
